mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE active_consent AS ( SELECT consent.user_id, DATE(consent.updated_at) AS consent_date FROM tbl_user_consent consent JOIN tbl_user user ON user.id = consent.user_id WHERE consent.consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND consent.status = 1 AND consent.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND (consent.expires_at IS NULL OR consent.expires_at > NOW()) AND user.status = 'ACTIVE' ), recovery_date AS ( SELECT MIN(consent_date) AS assign_date FROM active_consent WHERE consent_date < #{beforeDate} UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(assign_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM recovery_date WHERE DATE_ADD(assign_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) < #{beforeDate} ) SELECT MIN(calendar.assign_date) FROM recovery_date calendar WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM active_consent consent WHERE consent.consent_date <= calendar.assign_date AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment WHERE assignment.user_id = consent.user_id AND assignment.assign_date = calendar.assign_date ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment WHERE assignment.user_id = consent.user_id AND assignment.assign_date = calendar.assign_date AND assignment.result = 'PENDING' ) ) )

SELECT user.id FROM tbl_user user WHERE user.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_consent consent WHERE consent.user_id = user.id AND consent.consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND consent.status = 1 AND consent.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND (consent.expires_at IS NULL OR consent.expires_at > NOW()) AND DATE(consent.updated_at) <= #{assignDate} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment WHERE assignment.user_id = user.id AND assignment.assign_date = #{assignDate} ) ORDER BY user.id
SELECT difficulty_id FROM tbl_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_user_mission_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND assign_date = #{assignDate}
SELECT id, difficulty_name, min_reduction_rate, max_reduction_rate FROM tbl_mission_difficulty WHERE id = #{difficultyId}

SELECT info.mission_id FROM tbl_user_mission_info info JOIN tbl_mission_pool pool ON pool.id = info.mission_id WHERE info.user_id = #{userId} AND pool.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY info.assign_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(daily.net_amount), 2) AS base_amount FROM ( SELECT tr_date, SUM(CASE WHEN is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(refunded_amount, amount) ELSE amount END) AS net_amount FROM tbl_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id = #{categoryId} AND tr_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND classification = 'CONSUMPTION' AND direction = 'OUT' AND is_excluded_from_summary = 0 GROUP BY tr_date HAVING net_amount > 0 ) daily
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_user_mission_info (user_id, mission_id, difficulty_id, assign_date, target_rate, target_value, base_amount, assignment_reason) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionId}, #{difficultyId}, #{assignDate}, #{targetRate}, #{targetValue}, #{baseAmount}, #{assignmentReason})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_user_mission_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND assign_date = #{assignDate}
mapper.select: SELECT assignment.user_id, mission.mission_title FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment JOIN tbl_mission_pool mission ON mission.id = assignment.mission_id JOIN tbl_user user ON user.id = assignment.user_id WHERE assignment.assign_date = #{assignDate} AND assignment.result = 'PENDING' AND user.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_consent consent WHERE consent.user_id = assignment.user_id AND consent.consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND consent.status = 1 AND consent.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND (consent.expires_at IS NULL OR consent.expires_at > NOW()) ) ORDER BY assignment.id
